```{python}
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree

import pandas as pd

from rent_project.config import (
    PROCESSED_DIRECTORY,
)
```

Loading data
```{python}
data = pd.read_parquet(PROCESSED_DIRECTORY / "greater_london_abplus_spine.parquet")
```

Checking data is ok

```{python}
# overall size
len(data) # 4 151 457

# number of dwellings
len(data[
    (data["is_residential_2011"] == True)
    & (data["state_2011"].eq("2") | data["state_2011"].isna())
]) # 3 450 307 dwellings in 2011

len(data[
    (data["is_residential_2021"] == True)
    & (data["state_2021"].eq("2") | data["state_2021"].isna())
]) # 3 795 583 dwellings in 2021

len(data[
    (data["is_residential_2026"] == True)
    & (data["state_2026"].eq("2") | data["state_2026"].isna())
]) # 3 956 394 dwellings in 2026

# number of private rented dwellings
len(data[data["private_rented_2011"] == True]) # 878 151 private rented in 2011
len(data[data["private_rented_2021"] == True]) # 1,174,022 private rented in 2021

# average estimated rent (not imputed)
data.groupby("est_rent_imputed")["est_rent_2011"].agg(["mean", "count"])
data.groupby("est_rent_imputed")["est_rent_2014"].agg(["mean", "count"])
data.groupby("est_rent_imputed")["est_rent_2021"].agg(["mean", "count"])
data.groupby("est_rent_imputed")["est_rent_2024"].agg(["mean", "count"])
```
